worldcombat.skill.thundercage.summary: A jolt of electricity raises a ring of vertical current bars around the target, sealing it in a cage: cross the bars and an arc throws you back with a shock, while the cage keeps striking it and may paralyze it. It pins no one, but no one walks out between the bars. The wide style is broader and lasts longer; the tight style is smaller and shocks harder.
worldcombat.skill.thundercage.use.0: Lock a highly mobile target into a small patch of ground
worldcombat.skill.thundercage.use.1: Pressure a foe with repeated shocks and paralysis
worldcombat.skill.thundercage.use.2: Throw a charging target back into the fight
worldcombat.skill.thundercage.use.3: Lock down a key target in a narrow place
worldcombat.skill.thundercage.descriptio: The jolt deals %1$s special damage and raises a ring of current bars around the target.
The cage lasts %1$s and strikes for %3$s power every %2$s; each strike has a %4$s chance to paralyze the target.
Cage radius %1$s blocks; crossing the bars throws the target back %2$s blocks with a shock; range %3$s blocks, bolt speed %4$s blocks per tick.
